title: More than 50 Dem lawmakers demand more Schedule F transparency
summary: Efforts to understand the true scope of the recent executive order moving around 8,000 career federal jobs into Schedule Policy/Career, making their incumbents effectively at-will employees, have been stymied by the administration’s scant public documentation.

title: FEMA overhaul proposal spotlighted by bipartisan lawmakers
summary: Supporters testified that the FEMA Act would help disaster survivors and local governments more easily access assistance.

title: CDC nominee faces questions over whether she can lead the agency independently
summary: Dr. Erica Schwartz sought to reassure senators she would follow the science as lawmakers pressed her on vaccines, abortion data and disease surveillance.

title: VA’s push to shorten benefits forms needs more public input
summary: The Department of Veterans Affairs is asking veterans and others to weigh in on proposed changes to two lengthy applications.

title: Space Development Agency resumes launches with its future in doubt
summary: The agency says it has addressed the technical issues that delayed its latest satellite mission, even as lawmakers consider folding it into the Space Force.

title: Arbitrator restores telework and remote work at the Forest Service
summary: The U.S. Forest Service violated its collective bargaining agreement with the National Federation of Federal Employees last year when it unilaterally canceled telework and remote work agreements en masse as part of the Trump administration’s return-to-office mandate.

title: ICE is pulling back on vehicle stops after 2 fatal shootings
summary: A new enforcement directive follows growing scrutiny from lawmakers as questions mount about recent killings and the agency's tactics.

title: Former civil servants and union request IG investigation into transfer of Education program to Labor
summary: House Republicans recently introduced a package of bills that would codify the Trump administration’s interagency agreements that move Education offices to other agencies.

title: AI won’t replace human claims processors, VA officials say, as Democrats worry over staffing levels
summary: Rep. Nikki Budzinski, D-Ill., said some VA employees report claims processing technologies are producing incorrect information.

title: What federal officials still haven't explained about the Houston ICE shooting
summary: Investigators are seeking evidence, lawmakers are demanding transparency and several key details remain out of public view.

title: Duffy faces new ethics complaint over official social media post promoting wife’s book
summary: The Transportation Department said that the post at issue was "inadvertently retweeted” by a staffer.

title: DHS network intrusion was twice ruled a false positive before breach confirmed
summary: Suspicious activity on the Homeland Security Information Network, which is being used to support World Cup games around the U.S., was first detected around mid-to-late May.

title: The biggest story in the federal workforce cuts isn't how many left, it's who wasn't replaced
summary: COMMENTARY | The data suggest the workforce reduction reshaped not just the size of government, but the expertise available to carry out its work, one expert argues.

title: Sen. Lindsey Graham dies, leaving Senate seat vacant
summary: The longtime South Carolina Republican chaired the Senate Budget Committee and led a key appropriations panel.

title: Trump empties out election commission leadership just months before midterms
summary: Career staff can continue day-to-day operations, but the leadership gap could affect decisions on voting technology, standards and federal election programs.

title: Fired EPA dissenters sue for reinstatement, alleging First Amendment violations
summary: Seven former EPA employees said they were targeted for removal for signing an open “declaration of dissent” in their personal capacities because they had fewer civil service protections rather than any wrongdoing.

title: IRS missed hiring goals for 2026 tax season, which watchdog says impacted service performance
summary: The tax agency temporarily reassigned hundreds of employees to cover the gaps in staffing.

title: Calls grow for an independent probe into fatal Houston ICE shooting
summary: House Democrats are demanding body camera footage and answers from DHS and ICE, arguing the agencies have yet to back up their public account of the encounter.

title: Transportation loses its top tech official amid wave of CIO departures
summary: Pavan Pidugu, who led the department's IT modernization efforts, will step down in September as turnover among federal technology leaders continues.

title: HUD's tech chief appears headed for Interior
summary: The expected pick would replace the agency's recently departed technology chief and continue a string of leadership changes.

title: No more paper: Navigating OPM’s new digital retirement process
summary: As the Office of Personnel Management completes its transition away from paper, federal employees and retirees must adapt to a streamlined — but strictly digital — process for securing their benefits.

title: Judges block Trump effort to narrow public service loan forgiveness
summary: The rulings preserve existing eligibility rules for now while testing how much authority the Education Department has to reshape a popular benefit for public service workers.

title: Unions sue to restore DOD collective bargaining rights, asserting ‘chaos’
summary: A new lawsuit alleges that Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth’s order last April to terminate most union contracts led to a slapdash implementation process that stripped bargaining rights even from those exempt from President Trump’s anti-labor executive orders.
